test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The mean and the mode of a set of data are 47.4 and 61.6, respectively. Find the median of the data set, using the empirical formula.

(Round off your answer to one decimal place.)
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ Apply the **Empirical Formula**: 3 × **Median** = **Mode** + 2 × **Mean** 3 × **Median** = 61.6 + 2 × 47.4 = 61.6 + 94.8 = 156.4 **Median** = 156.4 ÷ 3 = 52.133... **∴ The correct answer is 52.1.**
